boundary_rationale: Onset: the verse opens on the hand-of-YHWH idiom immediately followed by a transport verb, oshb:Ezek.37.1 הָיְתָ֣ה עָלַי֮ יַד יְהוָה֒ וַיּוֹצִאֵ֤נִי בְר֨וּחַ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַיְנִיחֵ֖נִי בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבִּקְעָ֑ה וְהִ֖יא מְלֵאָ֥ה עֲצָמֽוֹת -- the same onset shape that opens the book's other three long prose visions, and this occurrence is one of only 7 hand-of-YHWH verses in the book. The unit runs as one uninterrupted scene: the prophet is set down among the bones (37.1-2), questioned and commanded to prophesy twice -- once to the bones, once to the breath/spirit (37.4-6, 37.9), watches the two-stage reanimation (37.7-8, 37.10), and receives the scene's own interpretation as a word to 'son of man' (address.son_of_man, oshb:Ezek.37.11 וַיֹּאמֶר֮ אֵלַי֒ בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה כָּל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵ֑מָּה הִנֵּ֣ה אֹמְרִ֗ים יָבְשׁ֧וּ עַצְמוֹתֵ֛ינוּ וְאָבְדָ֥ה תִקְוָתֵ֖נוּ נִגְזַ֥רְנוּ לָֽנוּ). Close: oshb:Ezek.37.14 stacks three refrain-grade closes in one verse -- the second-person plural recognition variant ('and you will know that I am YHWH', part of a 21-verse 2mp family sweep), the emphatic 'I YHWH have spoken' close (one of 14 book-wide), and the short utterance signature without the divine-name pair (one of only 4 such short forms in the book) -- וְנָתַתִּ֨י רוּחִ֤י בָכֶם֙ וִחְיִיתֶ֔ם וְהִנַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם עַל אַדְמַתְכֶ֑ם וִידַעְתֶּ֞ם כִּי אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִׂ֖יתִי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה, and a pe mark is recorded immediately after this verse (tier-3 single-witness, informing not deciding). Both sides of the following seam were weighed: oshb:Ezek.37.15 opens with the strict word-event formula וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר, one of 39 verses carrying that strict form, so the close at 37.14 and the fresh onset at 37.15 corroborate each other from both directions.

boundary_rationale: Onset: oshb:Ezek.39.1 opens וְאַתָּ֤ה בֶן אָדָם֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א עַל גּ֔וֹג וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָֽל, combining the ‘and you, son of man’ sub-onset with a messenger formula and the near-verbatim ‘behold, I am against you, Gog’ verdict already given at oshb:Ezek.38.3. This sub-onset carries no word-event formula of its own -- the strict and any-form word-event sweeps both stop at 38.1 -- so 39.1 stands in the same structural class as 36.1 (both open a fresh command inside an earlier word-event's span rather than a new one). A row seam is taken here because 39.1 does carry real, present onset evidence of its own kind, and because the strict recognition formula plus samekh mark at 38.23 (behind it) already closed the preceding paragraph; the seam is not read as automatic from the chapter division alone. Close: three utterance-formula closes fall inside 39.1-10 (39.5, 39.8, 39.10); the first two are paragraph-final rather than row-final because no fresh onset follows either, and the last, oshb:Ezek.39.10 וְלֹֽא יִשְׂא֨וּ עֵצִ֜ים מִן הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְלֹ֤א יַחְטְבוּ֙ מִן הַיְּעָרִ֔ים כִּ֥י בַנֶּ֖שֶׁק יְבַֽעֲרוּ אֵ֑שׁ וְשָׁלְל֣וּ אֶת שֹׁלְלֵיהֶ֗ם וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ אֶת בֹּ֣זְזֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה, is taken as the row-final close because a samekh mark is recorded immediately after it, corroborating the text-formula evidence from the masoretic tradition as well.
